thread:
alex-partners: FYI: running a short pilot to standardize SI handoffs for marketplace + hw partner leads. Goal: single source of truth, faster ACKs, and clear AE guidance. Draft rules below.

tara: love this. can we make the default claim window 24h for SMB, 48h for mid-market, 72h for enterprise? simpler than dollar cutoffs.

devin: +1 on tiers. how do we detect enterprise? use ARR field + existing account tags?

alex-partners: yes, pipeline tier based on `account_tier` in CRM. fallback: annual_contract_value > 250k => enterprise.

rachel: note on hardware-led deals: if lead_source == "marketplace-hw" then route to hw-integ queue first. hw team to assess and either claim or mark "requires-si" which then notifies SI duty. avoids noisy SI claims.

hw-integ: confirmed. we'll use a 48h triage SLA. if hw wants SI engaged immediately, they add tag `si-engage-now`.

ops-bot: [bot] New intake: IntegratorX via marketplace-hw -> ACME Industries. Routing: hw-integ queue.

tara: joint-announcement checklist suggestion: 1) partner PR approval, 2) joint customer quote (legal signoff), 3) launch date lock, 4) channel assets (1 pager + co-branded demo). Add to intake so we catch announcements early.

devin: add a requirement: confirm infra/compliance path for customer data if deployment will be Private/VPC. That often blocks SI scheduling.

alex-partners: good call. I'll add a mandatory intake field `deploy_mode` with options: hosted/dedicated/private. If private -> auto-cc security & solutions-eng.

rachel: question: account mapping rules. proposals: match by canonical_domain, fallback to parent_account via company_number, last-resort manual triage. keep a mapping history log.

tara: also set ownership precedence: AE > field-advocate > SI-claim. SI can request ownership but must coordinate with AE.

alex-partners: decision summary: - Tiered claim windows (SMB 24h / Mid 48h / Enterprise 72h). - marketplace-hw routes to hw-integ; hw flags SI needs. - deploy_mode field required; private routes to security + solutions. - ownership precedence AE > field-advocate > SI. - joint-announce checklist added to intake. Pilot: 3 weeks starting next Mon, SI duty roster covered by devin & tara.

hw-integ: we'll run hw triage SOP and post docs in Confluence under Partners > Intake SOP.

ops-bot: [bot] Pilot roster created: devin (Mon/Wed) tara (Tue/Thu) backups: rachel.

alex-partners: thanks. I'll put a one-slide AE cheat sheet and a sample webhook payload for intake teams. Paste example payload: 
```
{
  "lead_source":"marketplace",
  "partner":"IntegratorX",
  "account":"ACME Industries",
  "account_tier":"enterprise",
  "deploy_mode":"private",
  "requested_support":"si_engage"
}
```

tara: short ask: ops-bot should ping @oncall-si at 12h if tier != SMB and no claim.

alex-partners: noted. final ask: react with :white_check_mark: once you've read the Confluence playbook; I'll post link shortly.
